root.label: Federal student loan consolidation and rehabilitation procedures

events.label: Federal student loan consolidation and rehabilitation procedures

slots.name: default threshold days
slots.sentence: Borrowers are considered in default when they are at least 270 days behind on payments.

slots.name: consolidation processing time
slots.sentence: The consolidation process typically takes around 60 days to complete.

slots.name: rehabilitation payments required
slots.sentence: Through this program, borrowers are enrolled in a reduced payment plan and, after five successful payments, wage garnishment ends.
